headline: Waves transfer energy without transferring matter—the medium vibrates but doesn't travel
universal_truth: Influence can spread without anything physical moving from source to destination
fun_facts: When a wave passes through water, the water itself barely moves—it just rises and falls in place
Light is a wave that doesn't need a medium—it travels through empty space
Tsunamis can travel across entire oceans at jet-plane speeds carrying enormous energy
discussion_questions: What 'waves' of influence have passed through your life without direct contact?
How can energy transfer without anything physical moving?
What waves are you creating that might reach people you'll never meet?

hook.script: Watch an ocean wave roll toward shore. It looks like water rushing in. But drop a cork in the water and watch: it bobs up and down as the wave passes, then stays roughly where it was. The energy traveled, but the water didn't. That's the magic of waves.

cliff.script: If waves carry energy without carrying matter, how does the energy get from one place to another? What's actually moving across the ocean—or through the air when you hear music?

options.text: Each particle pushes the next, passing energy along like a chain reaction
options.response: Exactly. Particles oscillate and transfer energy to neighbors—a domino effect of vibration.

options.text: The wave creates a vacuum that pulls energy forward
options.response: No vacuum is created—it's more like a relay race...

fact1.title: The Domino Effect
fact1.script: Imagine a line of dominoes. Push one, and the motion travels down the line—but each domino only tips and recovers. Waves work similarly: particles oscillate, transferring energy to their neighbors. The pattern moves; the material stays.

fact2.title: Light Needs No Medium
fact2.script: Sound waves need air. Water waves need water. But light is special—it's an electromagnetic wave that travels through empty space. Light from the Sun crosses 93 million miles of vacuum to reach your eyes. Some waves are self-sufficient.

fact3.title: Tsunami Power
fact3.script: Tsunamis can cross entire oceans at 500 mph, barely noticeable in deep water. But as they approach shore and the ocean shallows, all that energy compresses into a towering wall of destruction. Energy that traveled thousands of miles arrives in seconds.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Influence works like waves. An idea, a kindness, a piece of art can travel far from its source, affecting people the creator will never meet. You don't have to touch someone to move them.

outro.script: That's Day 47. Tomorrow, we'll explore the delightful science of bubbles. Until then, watch a wave—any wave—and appreciate how energy travels while matter stays home.

growTrack.title: Wave Making - Consider Your Influence
growTrack.learning_objective: Recognize the waves of influence you create
growTrack.activity: Think of one thing you've said or done that might have rippled beyond your immediate circle—advice someone shared, an action that inspired others. You're always making waves. Consider: what waves do you want to create?
